name: Accessible Calendar - Multiday
description: Improve rendering of events spanning multiple days.
project_description: Accessible Calendar - Multiday is an optional companion submodule of Accessible Calendar. When enabled it hooks the calendar's day-cell preprocessing to add multiday metadata and CSS classes to each rendered event row, plus a small CSS/JS library, so that an event spanning several days renders as one continuous visual sequence across the calendar cells. It adds data-accessible-calendar-instance / data-accessible-calendar-instances attributes and is-multi, is-multi--first, is-multi--middle and is-multi--last classes. It provides no configuration, routes, permissions, or services of its own; disabling it leaves the base calendar working but without the continuous multiday styling.
